resources.string: Your kitchen companion for saving recipes, planning meals, and building grocery lists.
Use the in-app browser to find your favorite recipes on the web, then tap Download to save them straight to your account.
Open any recipe and start Cook Mode from the recipe detail screen to follow along step by step while you cook.
Add a recipe’s ingredients to your grocery list with a tap, so you never forget an item at the store.
Add recipes to breakfast, lunch, dinner, or snacks for any day of the week with the meal planner.
Everything’s ready to go. Let’s start cooking!
